Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose AI InteleKt only if your buying job matches “AI InteleKt is a customer data and retail intelligence platform — unify POS, web, and mobi” rather than Rank Prompt's shape. Choose Rank Prompt only if your buying job matches “AI SEO and search marketing platform — affiliate partner in the AI category.” rather than AI InteleKt's shape. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.
